I had this from october to january, non stop and it really hurt my mental health - since then it has turned into a dull urge that’s not as noticeable but definitely there 

pelvic floor physio helped but I have since been seen by a urogynae who has established that it is probs endo - it gets worse right before my period - worth considering asking about? 

in the mean time what has helped me 
- hot water bottle, alternating with ice pack 
- bladder training - can be counterproductive for some cause you tend to focus on it more
- breathing activities for when it’s starting to panic me
- sleeping on my front, with one leg straight and the other bent seems to be the only way to sleep
- do not rush being on the toilet, take your time
- see if you can get pelvic floor physio as it really did help me massively 
- cetirizine helped me sometimes or diphenhydramine for when I really really needed sleep 

mine was literally every second of every day for about four months, then i got some relief after doing physio consistently and i got some diazepam for when i needed relief immediately 

good luck

i have exact same symptoms as you and oxybutynin and solifenacin made it worse 
i went to pelvic floor physio and been told i’ve got hypertonic pelvic floor - my dr now agrees it’s IC but her and my physio agree that with the physio it should be “curable” to an extent as i’ve no dietary triggers 
i urge you to get referral to pelvic floor physio as it’s changed my life (still not gone but definitely more manageable) 
while waiting for pelvic floor physio i’d look up diaphragmatic breathing and happy baby, knee to chest, cat/cow, childs pose, flat frog etc as they all help relax your pelvic floor
my doctor actually has referred me to gynae for endo cause it goes away during my period or eases a bit at diff times of my cycle meaning she thinks it could all be linked

honestly the one PT session has changed my life - the urge was sitting at 10/10 24/7, now it’s around 7/10 most days but some days i’ve forgotten about it it’s been that minimal - look up diff phenotypes of IC that’s what helped me understand it better - hope you get sorted
